rejectedCandidates.reason: Live-verified during independent spot-check: reference 210.55.42.20.99.001's own official on-page title is literally '씨마스터 다이버 300M 제임스 본드 탄생 60주년 기념' (Seamaster Diver 300M James Bond 60th Anniversary) -- i.e. where a Bond connection is real, Omega already states it as the official name, not an informal nickname. The looser generic press habit of calling the whole Diver 300M line a 'Bond watch' does not precisely map to one full reference as required by this project's rule (俗稱只有在能精確對應完整配置並附可信來源時才可採用), so it is not adopted as either a localNickname or a collectionAlias (collectionAliases in the current schema are also only family-level (seamaster/speedmaster/constellation/de-ville), too coarse to accurately scope a Diver-300M-only association without misrepresenting Aqua Terra/Planet Ocean models under the same family).
